mapper.select: SELECT MEMBER_ID FROM LIFE WHERE LIFE_ID = #{lifeId}
mapper.update: UPDATE LIFE_QUEST SET POINT_GIVEN = 'Y' WHERE LIFE_ID = #{lifeId} AND ACHIEVED = 'Y' AND POINT_GIVEN = 'N'
UPDATE MEMBER SET POINT = POINT + #{amount} WHERE MEMBER_ID = #{memberId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO POINT_HISTORY (POINT_ID, MEMBER_ID, LIFE_ID, AMOUNT, REASON, CREATED_AT) VALUES (SEQ_POINT_HISTORY.NEXTVAL, #{memberId}, #{lifeId}, #{amount}, 'QUEST', SYSDATE)
mapper.select: SELECT Q.QUEST_ID, Q.QUEST_TYPE, Q.TARGET_VALUE FROM LIFE_QUEST LQ JOIN QUEST Q ON LQ.QUEST_ID = Q.QUEST_ID WHERE LQ.LIFE_ID = #{lifeId} AND LQ.ACHIEVED IS NULL
SELECT STATUS, BIRTH_YEAR, DEATH_AGE, EDU_LEVEL, SCHOOL_STATUS, BIRTH_COUNTRY, CURRENT_COUNTRY, CHILD_COUNT, AVG_INCOME, ASSETS, HAPPINESS FROM LIFE WHERE LIFE_ID = #{lifeId}
SELECT LIFE_EXPECTANCY, GDP_PER_CAPITA FROM COUNTRY_STAT WHERE COUNTRY_CODE = #{countryCode} AND DECADE = LEAST(#{decade}, (SELECT MAX(DECADE) FROM COUNTRY_STAT WHERE COUNTRY_CODE = #{countryCode}))

SELECT AVG(NVL(Y.INCOME, 0) / S.GDP_PER_CAPITA) AS INCOME_RATIO FROM LIFE_YEAR_LOG Y JOIN COUNTRY_STAT S ON S.COUNTRY_CODE = Y.COUNTRY_CODE AND S.DECADE = LEAST(TRUNC(Y.YEAR_NO / 10) * 10, (SELECT MAX(DECADE) FROM COUNTRY_STAT WHERE COUNTRY_CODE = #{country})) WHERE Y.LIFE_ID = #{lifeId} AND Y.COUNTRY_CODE = #{country} AND S.GDP_PER_CAPITA > 0
